entries.title: The Withheld Name
entries.signal: Shore's birth name exists — faint script on a certificate in the historian's shed, primary source long since taken to the dump — and Leif is its sole surviving carrier. He refuses to circulate it, and it never appears anywhere in the book, appendix included; its non-appearance is the payoff. The rooftop's hidden joint: he declares himself a single unrouted node while Katita's napkin diagram sits on the table.
entries.interference: Born on the page, not in planning — drafted into the rooftop scene and ratified next day. Enforced by the Proof Room provenance test: any candidate name or strong hint is an automatic FAIL. Protection instead of display for the First Nations material.
entries.note: TMAPO-Bible.md → The Elias Shore thread → The withheld name

entries.title: The Module, the Appendix & the Moral Centre
entries.signal: The moral centre named: the book is a love story wearing philosophical fiction — how do we continue loving someone when certainty is no longer possible? One surviving module answers by chance, months before the train; its Sappho-like fragments (authorship unresolved: Leif, Katita, ROOT, unattributable) later appear as a bureaucratically-titled appendix the reader slowly recognises as love poems. Katita becomes the final formal author. Leif receives not closure but permission to stop requiring closure.
entries.interference: Three integration rulings proposed, awaiting ratification: keep the once-only check (it is the check that answers); fold the response into the hotel-signal block, no new pages; the silent map still ends the novel, the appendix follows as apparatus outside the fourth warning's reach.
entries.note: TMAPO-Bible.md ✦ The Module, the Appendix & the Moral Centre

entries.title: The Four Warnings & the Scene Ranking
entries.signal: Ratified guardrails for the remainder. Chronology is causal for the writer, provisional for the reader — unresolved seams required; the Boxer and courtesan keep a different ontological texture, the drains stay uncertified, vaporwave contaminates rather than being labelled. Six full scenes: one genuinely happy road-years scene, the storm, Bell-Birds, the hammer, the split, the arrival. Five medium scenes; everything else flecks that flash and vanish. The masthead's provenance contaminated — never the title's certificate of birth.
entries.interference: Craig's own fourth warning: the ending suite must not become a basket carrying every remaining motif. Final cluster — ostinato, small tree or wren, uncertain arrival, silent ASCII map. The rest stays subterranean, already vibrating underneath.

entries.title: Borrowed Places & the Couch-Surfing Map
entries.signal: Young Leif lives through temporary shelters: girlfriends' couches, rooftops, drains, bookshops, cheap rooms. Establishes his habit of turning places into interior worlds and making companions from books. Formal object: an ASCII map of the unstable social geography — couches, the Cooks Hill bookstore, the Elias Shore gym, Sans Courte, beaches, drains, pubs.
entries.interference: Rhymes with the closing full-page ASCII map — the remainder opens and closes on maps of intimacy. Watch: literalising Paperback as biography presses on the nested ontology.

entries.title: The Drain Walk
entries.signal: Teenage Leif descends into Newcastle's stormwater channels with a torch and thongs: echoes, graffiti, oil sheen, roots, daylight at the far end. The hidden civic circulation met bodily, decades before ROOT.
entries.interference: Passes the silent-philosophy test as written — 'no explicit connection to ROOT is required' is the right instinct. A quiet plant for the boy who will hide archives inside trees.

entries.title: The Shed, the Father & Tape as Bookbinding
entries.signal: Through his parents' garden work Leif enters the boxing historian's shed: Fighters of the North, Elias Shore under conflicting names, the star on the shorts. The Boxer's taped hands and the taped paperback are bound for the same reason — to endure more work.
entries.interference: Extends the Endgame's Elias Shore thread cleanly. The microfiche 'masthead ancestor' ('this most august public organ' as inherited civic rhetoric) must stay one contested provenance among several — an etymology would deflate the title's recurrence.

entries.title: The Split Receiver: Boxer & Courtesan
entries.signal: One imagined correspondent divides in two: the Boxer receives through the body (tape, stance, defeat); the courtesan receives through language (paperbacks, letters, bathwater). She reads the same novels he excerpts — the readership of one. The final letter is rain-damaged, authorship unresolvable. Plus the Boxer anti-game: a vaporwave fighter whose objective is to avoid fights, travel with her, and lose correctly.
entries.interference: Deepens Endgame Movements 2–4 without contradiction; the anti-game is pure Total Refusal. The revelation lands later on the train — keep it a redistribution of emotional truth, never a twist.

entries.title: The Rooftop as a Real Party
entries.signal: The rooftop expands into a sensory world before it turns philosophical: fairy lights, coal ships like watch batteries, the starfield skirt, the maths shirt, the pen pulled from Leif's beard, the node diagram on a napkin. Katita's insight arrives as engineering: enough routes that the message survives losing one.
entries.interference: Directly executes Endgame Movement 5 and the field-guide rule: she solves a technical problem instead of declaring a thesis. The Shore conversation reveals uncertainty through documents, not position statements.

entries.title: Primes on Skin / The Biro Annotation
entries.signal: Katita taps sequences on Leif's forearm in the dark; he guesses prime or not prime, gladly wrong. She writes a word or tiny image on his skin and he doesn't wash it off. The body becomes a temporary page.
entries.interference: Threads to Andrew's faded tattoo, the bathwater text, bark and file — and returns ten years later as the unconscious tapping the slowing train resolves by one added beat. Strongest new motif system in the batch.

entries.title: Shared Digital Worlds & the Dead-Server Tour
entries.signal: Before ROOT is a mission it's pleasure: obsolete games, SecondLife-era Newcastle, low-poly harbour renders, abandoned servers. Leif gives a local-history tour through an abandoned virtual Newcastle; three silent avatars begin following him, never resolved.
entries.interference: Gives ROOT the origin the Wound needs — curiosity and play, not collapse-fear. Pixel-pastoral register: hardware tiny, light enormous.

entries.title: The Road Years as Lived Pleasure
entries.signal: The truck years feel like actual life: river bathing at dusk with cattle watching; the working payphone whose ten digits Leif still knows years later; deliberately outdated road maps he sometimes obeys against the landscape; the invented Big Thing, rusting and bird-filled; Katita war-dialling the paddocks at night until one modem answers — I'm here.
entries.interference: The After Page 38 correction applied at scale: scene-time, bodies, humour. Also the page-budget pressure point — pick three or four of these for full scenes; the rest are single sentences.

entries.title: The Vernacular Republic
entries.signal: Australia already contains public memory-organs: honour boards, pub PA systems, CB handles, motel registers, handwritten menus, taped books, microfiche, country radio. ROOT does not invent public memory — it tries to give the vernacular republic a battery.
entries.interference: One inventory page or file tree, once. The thesis in that last sentence must never be spoken by a character.

entries.title: The Network Becomes a Body
entries.signal: A storm crosses the valley and the nodes report it in sequence — one goes dark, another receives the front minutes later — while Leif and Katita feel the same weather on their skin. Cicadas saturate the acoustic sensors: the bush has more bandwidth than the archive. Mould, ants, resin; lightning splits a node-tree and amber hardens over the board, data and wound sealed together.
entries.interference: The storm is the establishing event the corruption arc has been missing; cicada DoS is its comic counterweight. The amber survives on the dashboard to become an absence-marker after the split.

entries.title: Bell-Birds Convergence & Nodes Conversing
entries.signal: Katita recites Bell-Birds with one word wrong; the ROOT file holds the same altered wording. Provenance collapses four ways and stays collapsed. Later, two distant nodes exchange bird recordings on their own schedule — the children talking to each other instead of their parents.
entries.interference: №31, the Open Frequencies atlas's top bet, now placed as a central turning point. Keep it mostly silent and physical as specified — this is the book's hinge and it must not explain itself.

entries.title: The Hammer, the Split & the Pamphlet
entries.signal: The archive starts writing him: the interface supplies a word before he remembers it; files appear in Katita's style; his own life is refiled as source material. Leif walks toward a node with a hammer — the walk is the decision — and does not swing. The split stays practical: he wants provenance, she accepts emergence. She keeps the truck. He leaves with her pamphlet, On the Completion of White Centres by Non-Mathematical Systems, ending in a one-word chapter he cannot read.
entries.interference: The unswung hammer makes his later gentleness chosen rather than automatic — the strongest single addition. The pamphlet carries the white-centre pressure-point into his luggage. Field guide: spend Blankets_Drying.tmp here.

entries.title: Ten Years Inside Co-Authorship
entries.signal: Motorbike, clifftop hotels, 'research' whose object is unclear — he is looking for the shape her choice has taken in the world. Unsigned files in her cadence that he reads anyway; an improved node found in a fig tree in another state — her hand, folk technology, or ROOT redesigning itself; one signal check that proves only that the system continued without him; imagined node conversations across forty kilometres at dusk.
entries.interference: The once-only discipline on the signal check is right — guard it. The improved-node rumour is stronger than any proof of Katita; resist resolving it.

entries.title: Erring Together & the Arrival
entries.signal: Truth stays alive through contested relation, dramatised never stated: Katita and the tree sharing the altered poem, Andrew and Leif misremembering together, maps disagreeing with roads. Wrens nest in a dead module, eggs near residual solar warmth. The jetpack bushranger's playlist gathers everything the book has heard into one organ-like symphony. A small tree moves whole in the wind at the station; uncertain signs of Andrew; the closest thing to revelation is attention itself — then a silent full-page ASCII map belonging to the world that continues after him.
entries.interference: Adlestrop delivered, and the wren-nest earns the title's 'organ' one last time. Risk is density — six closing images in six pages; let the tree and the map do the most work.
